sentences.text: Wherein the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka has held  that the claim petition filed by the deceased claimant  could not have been prosecuted by his Legal Heirs since  death occurred after Five years of the accident and was  not related to the injuries sustained in the accident.

But it is pertinent to refer the following decisions:
 MFA No.20156/2013 (MV) : The Banch Manager,
United India Ins. Co. Ltd., Vs. Smt. Dundavva and Anr.
 Wherein the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka has held  that merely because no post mortem is done, it cannot  be held that there is no nexus between the accidental  injuries and death as the continuity of treatment of the  injuries sustained in the accident has been established.
 Civil Appeal No.4800/2021 dated 16.08.2021: The Oriental Ins. Co. Ltd., Vs. Kahlon @ Jasmail Singh Kahlon.
 Wherein the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India has  considered the decisions of the Hon'ble High Court of  Karnataka in Kanamma and Uttam Kumar case and  has held that the insurance company cannot evade from  its obligation by hiding behind the defence that the  death is attributable to the reasons other than the  accident.

However, the Respondent No.2 being insurer is liable to indemnify the Respondent No.1 and directed to deposit the compensation amount to the Petitioners within 60 days from today.

The Petitioner in MVC No.2263/2021 is entitled for a sum of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty housand only) with interest @ 6% p.a. SCCH - 25 34 MVC Nos.2263/2021 to 2265/2021 from the date of filing till the date of depositing the award amount.
On deposit of compensation and interest, entire amount shall be released to the petitioner by way of e-payment with due acknowledgment and proper identification.

The Petitioners in MVC No.2264/2021 is entitled for a sum of Rs.12,26,700/- (Rupees Twelve Lakhs Twenty Six Thousand Seven Hundred only) with interest @ 6% p.a. from the date of filing till the date of depositing the award amount.

On deposit of compensation and interest, Rs.44,000/- each shall be released to the petitioner Nos.1(b) & 1(c) and out of the remaining amount 25% shall be deposited in the name of the petitioner No.1(a) and remaining amount shall be released to the petitioner No.1(a) by way of e-payment with SCCH - 25 35 MVC Nos.2263/2021 to 2265/2021 due acknowledgment and proper identification.
The Petitioner in MVC No.2265/2021 is entitled for a sum of Rs.60,000/- (Rupees Sixty Thousand only) with interest @ 6% p.a. from the date of filing till the date of depositing the award amount.
On deposit of compensation and interest, entire amount shall be released to the petitioner by way of e-payment with due acknowledgment and proper identification.

Advocate fee is fixed at Rs.1000/-
in each case.
The original copy of this judgment is ordered to be kept in MVC No.2263/2021 and copy shall be kept in MVC No.2264/2021 & 2265/2021.
